pages.text: $(bold)Flim Flam$() builds bad luck in PvP and eventually fires a weighted prank - inventory shuffle, epic lore, dummy creepers, skyblock ice platforms, and more.$(br2)Safe/unsafe lists and $(code)safeOnly$() live in config. Ops can force effects with $(code)/opencubes flimflam$().
Strips generated epic lore from an item in the crafting grid.
